newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bemis raised to strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bemis raised to strong buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it upgraded Bemis Co Inc to strong buy from hold.
-- Raised 1996 earnings estimate to $1.85 per share from $1.80 and 1997 estimate to $2.10 from $1.90.
-- Said believes Bemis can sustain double-digit earnings growth over the next five years due to its superior manufacturing capabilities, technology and productivity.
-- Also cited Bemis as the best positioned company to consolidate the flexible packaging industry because of its conservative balance sheet and strong cash flow.
